title: tier-2 shipped code: the build-info row select against BuildInfoSelectRow (0x1424aec30)

unreachableBranches.why: Flavor-path count retest at exe 0x1424aec66 `test esi, esi` / 0x1424aec68 `je 0x1424aecdb`. esi is the count loaded at 0x1424aec3d, tested at 0x1424aec43 `je 0x1424aed7b` (return null on zero), and never rewritten (only read at 0x1424aecd1 `cmp r9d, esi`), so any run reaching this retest has count >= 1 and the je is never taken. The site runs on every non-empty-flavor case with count >= 1 and only its fall-through edge is observed.

Flavor post-mismatch compare at exe 0x1424aecca `cmp edx, ecx` / 0x1424aeccc `je 0x1424aecec`. It is reached only from the first-char jne at 0x1424aeca5 (al != dil, with edx = dil) and from the fall-through of the walk cmp at 0x1424aecc0 (al != dl); at 0x1424aecc4 ecx = dl and edx = al, so the compared bytes are already unequal on both entries and the je is never taken. The site runs on every flavor first-char or later-byte mismatch and only its fall-through edge is observed.

No-flavor count retest at exe 0x1424aed09 `test esi, esi` / 0x1424aed0b `je 0x1424aecdb`. Same proof as the flavor retest: esi is the entry count, zero already returns null at 0x1424aec43, and esi is never rewritten, so count >= 1 on every run reaching here and the je is never taken. The site runs on every null/empty-flavor case with count >= 1 and only its fall-through edge is observed.

No-flavor mismatch-exit compare at exe 0x1424aed55 `cmp cl, dl` / 0x1424aed57 `jne 0x1424aed7b`. It is reached only from the first-char jne at 0x1424aed3c (cl != dil, with dl = dil from 0x1424aed21) and from the fall-through of the walk cmp at 0x1424aed51 (cl != dl); cl/dl are unchanged between those tests and 0x1424aed55, so cl != dl always, the jne to the return-null block at 0x1424aed7b is always taken, and the fall-through to the active test at 0x1424aed59 is dead. The site runs on every no-flavor mismatch and only its taken edge is observed.

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-casc/src/install.rs::select_build_info_row (the byte view) over crates/ow-casc/src/install.rs::select_build_info_index (the shared index decision), built by cargo and called by crates/ow-casc/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the build_info_select_row entry. The ledger binds the verdict to install.rs + the probe source + the git revision. The typed select_build_info now runs through select_build_info_index, so the shipped path and the tested function are the same code, not a parallel copy; the shipped change was the empty-flavor rule (Some("") takes the no-flavor path), which the old typed code treated as a flavor match on the empty product.

Oracle is BuildInfoSelectRow at exe 0x1424aec30, measured extent 0x1424aec30..0x1424aed8b (347 bytes, 0x15b, through the ret at 0x1424aed8a; the .pdata root is only 0x1424aec30..0x1424aec6a, 0x3a bytes, and the body is the chained continuation, first instruction `mov [rsp+0x18], rbx` at the entry), which is the declared coverageWindow. v2b 0x7ff7c71cec30 is computed as 0x7ff7c4d20000 + (0x1424aec30 - 0x140000000) and cross-checked against fn/DynamicIndexFindEntry at 0x1425111a0 -> v2b 0x7ff7c72311a0. Signature: (table *table, const flavor *flavor) -> row * (RCX, RDX; RDX null allowed). The table supplies the rows pointer at +0x20 and the count (u32) at +0x28; rows are 0xb0 bytes each, Product is the qword at row +0 and the active byte is at row +0x10.

The shipped select_build_info_index matched the client operation for operation and needed only that empty-flavor correction: a zero count returns null at once; a null flavor or a flavor whose first byte is zero takes the no-flavor path; any other flavor is a byte-for-byte, case-sensitive equality (first-char pre-check, then the per-byte walk) against each row's Product, returning the first active match; the no-flavor path takes the first row's Product as the baseline, requires every row (active or not) to equal it before the active test, and returns the last active row. A null Product pointer selects the default at exe 0x142f7aa00, whose first byte is zero, so it compares as the empty string. The return is the selected row pointer or null.

Compared channels: the return as a u64 and the one 0x4000-byte table blob pointee. The probe returns the client's row pointer as an absolute arena address (ARENA_BASE + rows offset + row offset), or 0 for null, so the raw RAX comparison carries the selected row's offset from the rows base. The blob holds the header at 0 (rows field at +0x20 with a reloc rebasing the relative 0x1000, count at +0x28), the 0xb0-byte rows at 0x1000 with absolute Product pointers (0 for null), the Product strings at 0x2000 and the flavor string at 0x2800; the flavor argument is a u64 arena address (0 for null) so a null flavor is representable, and the probe resolves it to the C string in the blob. The function writes nothing, so the sentinel bytes pin that.

Coverage: the sweep finds 16 conditional branch sites. Four sites run with exactly one edge and are declared under unreachableBranches with the proofs in their why fields: the flavor count retest at 0x1424aec68 and the no-flavor count retest at 0x1424aed0b (esi is the entry count, zero returns null at 0x1424aec43, esi is never rewritten, so the je to 0x1424aecdb is never taken), the flavor post-mismatch compare at 0x1424aeccc (reached only when the compared bytes already differ, so the je to 0x1424aecec is never taken), and the no-flavor mismatch-exit compare at 0x1424aed57 (reached only when cl != dl, so the jne to 0x1424aed7b is always taken and the fall-through to 0x1424aed59 is dead). The remaining missed site, the no-flavor walk loop-back at 0x1424aed53, is genuinely reachable on both edges and is covered by new fixture cases ([("pro", True), ("pxo", True)], None) and ([("pro", True), ("pr", True)], None): the baseline and the second row share the first char, so the walk at 0x1424aed41..0x1424aed53 runs and exits on its fall-through, while the uniform no-flavor cases drive its taken loop-back edge. Honest arithmetic: 16 sites swept - 4 valid declarations = 12 reachable sites, and 12 both-edge sites / 12 reachable = 100.0%, floored to a gate of 100 (the measured both-edge count, so the gate never exceeds what was measured).

allowedImageReads lists the only image data the body reads: the empty-string default at exe 0x142f7aa00 (v2b 0x7ff7c7c9aa00), selected by the `lea`/`cmovne` when a Product pointer is null; only its first (zero) byte is ever compared. The function has no callees and no stack-cookie global.
